items.title: Scott Hamilton interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: my group would back him up in Boston

ctx.x: Who did you start working with when you felt like you were breaking in and getting a name for yourself.

That didn’t start to happen until I was about nineteen years old and I met Roy Eldridge. That was one of my first trips to New York. And we got together and arranged to do a job where my group would back him up in Boston. We lived in New England and worked around the Boston area. But this was our first chance to back somebody from out of town that had a name, you know, somebody that was big time. So that was pretty much it.
Tell us some things that you maybe have learned from Roy that you wouldn’t have learned in a book.
